terms.gloss: an orbit (of a planet or satellite)
terms.comment: Classically orbita is the rut a wheel leaves, a track (Cic. Att. 2.21.2, Lewis & Short); the astronomical sense is modern. Planets move in their orbēs or cursūs in classical writers.

terms.gloss: a circle, the circuit of a heavenly body

sources: Lewis & Short: orbita · Lewis & Short: orbis
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 354.
